scripts.lint:all: vp run --filter eslint-local-rules-shared build && vp lint . --fix && vp run -r lint:eslint && vp run lint:biome
scripts.lint:report: vp run --filter eslint-local-rules-shared build && node scripts/generate-lint-reports.mjs
scripts.check:safe: vp run typegen:all && vp run --filter eslint-local-rules-shared build && vp check && vp run typecheck:all && vp run -r lint:eslint:check && vp run lint:biome:check && vp run commands:verify && vp run coordination:verify && vp run scripts:verify && vp run test:all
scripts.check:push: vp run typegen:all && vp run --filter eslint-local-rules-shared build && vp check && vp run typecheck:changed && vp run -r lint:eslint:check && vp run lint:biome:check && vp run commands:verify && vp run coordination:verify && vp run scripts:verify
scripts.test:ci: vp run --filter '!@repo/scan-ingestion' --filter '!@repo/scan-orchestrator' --filter '!vite-react-compiler' test && vp run --filter @repo/scan-ingestion test:unit && vp run --filter @repo/scan-orchestrator test:unit && vp run --filter vite-react-compiler test:ci
scripts.ready: vp run check:safe && vp run build:all
scripts.db:up: docker compose -f docker/local/docker-compose.yml --env-file docker/local/.env up -d postgres pgadmin
scripts.coordination:board:live: gh pr list --state open --json number,title,headRefName,isDraft,url,statusCheckRollup --limit 200 | node scripts/coordination-board-live.mjs
